entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned advocate for the applicants.

2. The applicants are seeking quashment of Crime No. 331/2019, registered with MIDC Waluj Police Station, Aurangabad, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 313,
323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. It is necessary to note that already the applicants had once attempted for quashment of crime by filing Criminal Writ Petition No. 90/2020 which was dismissed by this Court by a speaking order dated 14.09.2022.
Without disclosing this fact and making a statement that no similar relief has been sought, this application has been filed.

4. Learned advocate for the applicants submits that she has not been instructed about rejection of the earlier writ petition but submits that earlier the applicants were seeking quashment of crime and now they are seeking quashment of charge-sheet.
The statements of the learned advocate are self 926 CRAPP 303 23.odt contradictory.

If she has not been informed about the earlier decision, one Padmesh Jayanarayan Laddha And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28837060/

sentences.text: 1 wonders how she comes to know that it was a writ petition for quashment of crime.
5. Be that as it may, by an elaborate order this Court has already refused to quash the crime on merits.
Filing of the charge-sheet is only a logical and legal corollary once crime is registered.
There is no material change in the circumstances since rejection of earlier petition except the fact that a charge- sheet has been filed.

(ABHAY S. WAGHWASE, J. ) (MANGESH S. PATIL, J.) mkd/-
